entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana with VeloFit. How can I assist you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand sensor. It's a complete waste of money and I'm not keeping it.
I'm very sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. To best help you, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
Don't play games with me. The whole thing is just confusing. It's supposed to be simple, but it's incredibly hard to use. I read the user manual and it's no help at all.
I understand your frustration. The interface does have many features. I'd be happy to walk you through the setup for the cadence tracking—

I don't want a lesson! I want a refund! I honestly expected more from this product. This is unacceptable. Either process my return right now or get me your manager. I'm one click away from telling everyone online how awful this experience has been.
Okay, okay, there's no need for that. I can certainly check on the return eligibility for you. Please hold on for just one moment while I pull up your order details.

Thank you for your patience. I see here that your VeloBand was delivered 21 days ago. Our company return policy is 90 days, so you are well within the timeframe for a full refund. I can authorize that for you right now.
Finally. About time. Send me the return label.

Of course. I've just processed the return authorization. You will receive an email with the prepaid shipping label and packing instructions within the next 15 minutes. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, your refund will be issued.
Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
